intro.fallback: Killer B having faked his capture at the hands of Taka, takes the opportunity to escape his duty as a guardian of his village.
At an unknown location, while he was practising singing with the leader of the enka ninja Sabu, Kisame Hoshigaki arrived.
After quickly dispatching Sabu's companion Ponta, a tanuki, Kisame went on to battle both Killer B and Sabu, feeding his sword, Samehada, with enough of the B's chakra to reveal its true form.

outro.fallback: Fū, sensing Mei and Chōjūrō coming, and unable to steal the Byakugan due its protective seal, attempted to trick Mei into dispelling the seal for him.
However, because his mannerisms were so different from the real Ao, Mei saw through the trick and forced Fū dispelled the technique himself.
